Frontken.why: precision cleaning, re-coating and refurbishment of semiconductor-equipment chamber components and process kits; its semiconductor volume rose on higher demand and strong orders from customers in Taiwan
Frontken.evidence: Frontken quarterly report (08-05-2026): volume in the semi-conductor space increased mainly due to higher demand and strong orders from our customers in Taiwan; Frontken product page: parts clean + parts refurbishment + parts management for critical chamber components (28nm to 5/3nm ready)

players.product: Precision cleaning, thermal-spray re-coating and refurbishment of semiconductor equipment chamber components and process kits (28nm to 5/3nm ready)

quarterly_data.signal: Product page: Frontken's semiconductor offering is parts clean, parts refurbishment and parts management - recycle cleaning, re-coating, repair and recovery of critical chamber components (28nm, 22/20nm, 16/14nm, 10nm, 7nm, 5/3nm ready), advanced precision chemistry cleaning, robotic HVOF, plasma and TWAS coatings (e.g. Yttria Y2O3, Alumina Al2O3, YSZ) and type II/III hard anodizing; it cleans components such as shields, CVD and PVD parts, process chambers and load lock chambers, and its R&D works on cleaning, coatings and materials for the 7nm node and below.
